Local topic

Storefront or service area: set it up right

Businesses that welcome customers at an address and businesses that travel to customers need different Business Profile setups.

Getting this right is the first step for any Downtown business, because it decides whether Google shows your address, your service area or both.

  • Storefront: address and hours shown
  • Service area: areas you serve listed
  • Hybrid: both, set up carefully

FAQ

SEO in Downtown: common questions

Straight answers to the questions Edmonton business owners ask us most.

Should I hide my address?

Only if customers do not visit you. Service area businesses list the areas they serve instead of showing an address.

Can I have a profile without an office?

Service area businesses can have a profile. We help you set it up correctly.

Do you work with Downtown businesses only?

No. We work across Edmonton. This page focuses on one topic many Downtown businesses ask about.
